sweep_method: Three axes. (1) Plan sweep: 240 optimized-plan cells = {PIPE = ordered_input's shape, UDTF = annotate_plan's real shape} x {bare SELECT, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, WHERE, LIMIT} x N in {1,2,4} x target_partitions in {1,2,4,8}, plus the same grid for the ordinal-only counterfactual, each cell machine-checked for insertion-between / merge-above / coalesce-above (v2plan.txt). (2) Execution sweep: {sorted, unsorted} x {[_row_id,_ordinal], [_ordinal]} x N in {1,2,4} compared as a row sequence and as literal arrow-IPC bytes, plus four SQL-over-provider arms with a 10 s liveness timeout, plus 12 residency arms (v2exec.txt). (3) Source sweep of the touched class: every `.execute(0` under crates/**/src (10 sites) to bound the root universe; every InferenceExec reference across crates to find the codec/engine/placement consumers; every `ordered_input(` call site to test the 'sorted input' premise per path.
